family: Understanding and Troubleshooting Your Phone's Cellular Service

steps.issue: Airplane Mode is ON, disabling all wireless radios including cellular
SIM card status shows "Missing" (not inserted or improperly seated)
SIM card status shows "Locked" (due to incorrect PIN or PUK entries) - escalate to technical support for assistance with SIM security
APN settings show "Incorrect"
APN reset changes do not apply until the device is rebooted
The line is suspended and the agent can lift the suspension (per general policy)
The suspension cannot be lifted by the agent (e.g., due to contract end date, or other reasons not resolvable by the agent) - escalate to technical support
Connected to 2G Network — MMS requires at least a 3G network connection; 2G networks are generally not suitable
Incorrect APN Settings: MMSC URL is not set
APN settings changes do not take effect until the device is restarted
Wi-Fi Calling Configuration interfering with MMS — "Wi-Fi Calling is ON"
Messaging App Lacks Necessary Permissions — "storage" and "sms" permissions are not listed as granted
